question.prompt: In \(\odot O\), minor arc \(AB\) and minor arc \(AC\) are equal, and \(\angle ABC=70^\circ\). Find the measure of \(\angle BAC\) (unit: degrees).

solutions.explanation: Equal arcs subtend equal chords, so \(AB=AC\). Thus, \(\angle ACB=\angle ABC=70^\circ\), and \(\angle BAC=180^\circ-70^\circ-70^\circ=40^\circ\).
solutions.title: Equal chords and an isosceles triangle
